concerns.text: FR-006 requires a *paired* t‑test comparing adaptive accuracy to the pre‑specified fixed baseline (ρ=0.5). Task T008 implements an *independent‑samples* t‑test, which weakens the statistical requirement and changes the inference method.
Success Criterion SC‑003 expects a paired‑sample t‑test p‑value. Because T008 uses an independent‑samples test, the criterion is not satisfied; the required acceptance metric is missing.
